seen.body:
## Behaviour
Per-target option `milestones = true`: an epic is mirrored as a forge milestone (title, description with the approving human's quote, optional due date from a new `due` header key) and its approved child issues are assigned to it. Forge interface: `ensure_milestone(spec) -> Milestone`, `assign_milestone(number, milestone)`, Unsupported where absent (Forgejo and GitLab each map to their own milestone API). Rules: reconcile description/due date only on drift; a repeat run writes nothing and reports unchanged; a closed milestone is not reopened by sync unless the epic is reopened; an item already in a different milestone is refused (never silently moved out of its campaign); only approved, non-draft epics become milestones; every write is read back and verified; the milestone is closed when the epic is completed and only if it has no open attached issues.

## Scenarios
- `sync_creates_the_milestone_once_and_assigns_children`: second sync issues zero milestone writes; prevents duplicate milestones.
- `repeat_run_reports_no_change`: unchanged is reported as unchanged; prevents callers believing the forge was altered.
- `draft_epic_is_not_mirrored_as_a_milestone`: a draft epic stays out; prevents pulling an unapproved plan into a campaign.
- `issue_in_another_milestone_is_refused_not_moved`: refusal before any write, nothing reassigned.
- `milestone_closes_only_when_epic_completed_and_no_open_issue`: verifies the close with a re-read.
- `milestone_description_carries_the_requesters_quote`: the recorded approval quote appears in the description; prevents anonymous campaigns.

## Reference coverage
Tests: campaign create is idempotent, adds the milestone and assigns plans, refuses a non-plan issue (three label shapes) before any write, refuses a plan in another milestone without writing, repeat reports no change and writes nothing, complete golden walk verifies the close (6 tests).

## Qew today
Missing; hook guard already advises 'an epic is the milestone; `qew sync` mirrors it' but sync mirrors epics only as issues. Priority 3: YAGNI until a user needs forge milestones.
seen.title: Mirror epics to forge milestones (opt-in per target) with idempotent reconcile and plan assignment
